title: Ant Beale brings a smash that feels good for every second on the new song "Have a Nice Day"
htmlContent:
American-based music star Ant Beale is relentlessly flanking the confines of his talents as a rapper. His trap-leaning, smooth R&B style has given rise to the fact that he's a force of ferocity in today's modern rap landscape. The talented lyrical genius does not disappoint in the release of his recent track, "Have a Nice Day."

Ant Beale's "Have a Nice Day" brings a mainstream sound that gives it an appeal that you know will help it travel worldwide. The song is created to uplift the spirits of the people of London and bring a bit more pride and confidence to the people with its infectious energy attached to it to make you let go and enjoy the artistry being displayed.
